summary: Meta agreed to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general on Wednesday, ending the trial in its second week and sending Meta's stock higher.

title: Meta, US states agree $18 bn settlement in landmark teen safety case
summary: Meta agreed to pay a coalition of US states as much as $16.7 billion and to impose sweeping new limits on how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram, according to a court filing on Wednesday that ends a landmark trial in California.The settlement ends the trial in its second week.
